## 🌐 Workflow 8 — CareerPulse: OAuth Job Hunter Web App, Split-Screen Studio & Career Academy

### 1. Public Career & Interview Academy (`GET /webhook/job-dashboard`)
- **Career & Analytics Blog**, **18+ Interview-Ready Q&A Vault**, **6-Pillar Interview Preparation Blueprint & Interactive Checklist**, and **30-60-90 Day Job Success Playbook**.

### 2. OAuth Protected Owner Command Center (`POST /webhook/job-dashboard-api`)
- **Desktop Split-Screen Studio**: Job Details, Control Buttons & Section Rewriter on the Left + Embedded Google Drive PDF & Live A4 Document Preview on the Right (`📄 Custom Resume` ↔ `✉️ Cover Letter` ↔ `🎓 Master Resume`).
- **Graphical Funnel & Analytics**, **Interactive Master Table**, **`Generate new jobs` (Non-Collision Batch 25)**, **LinkedIn Queue + `li_at` Cookie**, **Friends & HR Network**, and **Learned Rules & Portals Vault**.

-- Ensure user_id column exists across all tenant tables and enforce PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) ALTER TABLE resume_generations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE cover_letter_generations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE learned_rules ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE linkedin_activity_log ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE linkedin_network_contacts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE portal_credentials_vault ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE portal_apply_limits ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; ALTER TABLE job_hunter_eod_log ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id INT DEFAULT 1; DO $$ DECLARE tbl TEXT; tenant_tables TEXT[] := ARRAY[ 'resume_generations', 'cover_letter_generations', 'learned_rules', 'linkedin_activity_log', 'linkedin_network_contacts', 'portal_credentials_vault', 'portal_apply_limits', 'job_hunter_eod_log', 'user_gdpr_consents' ]; BEGIN FOREACH tbl IN ARRAY tenant_tables LOOP IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = tbl) THEN EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;', tbl); EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;', tbl); EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_policy ON %I;', tbl); EXECUTE format( 'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON %I ' || 'USING (user_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting(''app.current_user_id'', true), '''')::int, 1)) ' || 'WITH CHECK (user_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting(''app.current_user_id'', true), '''')::int, 1));', tbl ); END IF; END LOOP; END $$; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_gdpr_consents ( user_id INT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1, email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user@example.com', consent_profile_processing BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, consent_ai_tailoring BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, consent_portal_automation BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, consent_linkedin_outreach BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, consent_analytics BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, ip_hash TEXT DEFAULT '', policy_version TEXT DEFAULT '2026.10-GDPR', consented_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() ); INSERT INTO user_gdpr_consents (user_id, email) VALUES (1, 'user@example.com') ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gdpr_suppression_list ( contact_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT DEFAULT 'Art. 21 Right to Object / Do-Not-Contact', suppressed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gdpr_audit_erasure_log ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, receipt_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, email_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, action_type TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT DEFAULT '', executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() ); -- GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) 90-Day Storage Limitation Rolling Purge for Skipped/Rejected 3rd-Party Snippets DELETE FROM linkedin_activity_log WHERE approval_status IN ('Rejected / Skipped', 'Skipped (Denied)') AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'; DELETE FROM linkedin_network_contacts WHERE approval_status IN ('Skipped', 'Denied') AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'; ALTER TABLE linkedin_network_contacts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS messages_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]'; ALTER TABLE linkedin_network_contacts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS conversation_urn TEXT DEFAULT ''; UPDATE learned_rules SET triggered_by_comment = CASE WHEN triggered_by_comment IS NULL OR triggered_by_comment = 'Web App Manual Rule' THEN rule_instruction ELSE triggered_by_comment END, rule_instruction = 'SUMMARY — NO STATISTICS OR NUMERICAL METRICS DIRECTIVE: NEVER include percentages, numbers, record volumes, or quantitative metrics (such as "1M+ monthly records", "40%", "25%–30%", "84%", or "15+ launches") in the Summary section; reserve all numerical metrics strictly for the Experience section bullets. Instead, write a qualitative 3-sentence Summary grounded in Sumanto''s past experience across enterprise SQL/Python analytics, Tableau BI reporting, workflow automation, and stakeholder consulting, tailored directly to the current Job Description.' WHERE id = 686 OR rule_instruction ILIKE 'Don''t use statistics%' OR rule_instruction ILIKE '%Proven track record of analyzing 1M+%'; UPDATE learned_rules SET rule_instruction = 'SUMMARY — 80/20 GROUNDED EXPERIENCE & JD ALIGNMENT DIRECTIVE: Always open the Summary with the grounded title "Senior Data & Business Analyst" (never copy the target job title verbatim). Anchor 80% of the Summary in a qualitative synthesis of Sumanto''s real experience across enterprise data analytics, BI dashboard automation, operational process governance, and commercial stakeholder strategy (strictly WITHOUT numerical statistics or percentages), and weave in 20% (up to 2 overlapping competency phrases) aligned with the target Job Description.' WHERE id = 667 OR (section_name = 'summary' AND rule_instruction ILIKE '%80% Existing Experience%'); UPDATE role_few_shot_library SET sample_summary_html = '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of architecting automated data pipelines and interactive KPI reporting suites using SQL, Python, and Tableau to uncover operational bottlenecks and elevate cross-functional delivery quality. Adept at applying data cleaning and transformation and diagnostic root-cause analysis to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' WHERE sample_summary_html ~ '[0-9]+%|1M\+|15\+|5\+'; UPDATE resume_generations SET summary_html = CASE WHEN position_title ~* 'product|growth|funnel|experiment|retention|marketing' THEN '

careerpulse_ui_patches ORDER BY created_at DESC) up) AS ui_patches, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(pt)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM careerpulse_product_todos ORDER BY sort_order ASC, 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'LinkedIn Jobs') AND LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(session_cookies, ''), NULLIF(encrypted_password, ''), '')) > 15 LIMIT 1) AS li_at_cookie, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rg)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM resume_generations ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(s_no, resume_id, '0'), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) ASC NULLS LAST ) rg) AS resume_gens, (SELECT li_logs, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(fc)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM linkedin_network_contacts ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(contact_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST ) fc) AS fh_contacts, (SELECT row_to_json(ls) FROM ( SELECT * FROM linkedin_daily_stats WHERE stat_date = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1 ) ls) AS li_stats, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT site_name, portal_url, profile_review_url, login_method, auth_email, communication_email, username, auth_status, profile_approval_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name NOT IN ('Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub', 'CareerPulse_Web_Session', 'LinkedIn_Session_Cookie') ORDER BY site_name ASC ) v) AS vault_rows, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT site_name, portal_url, login_method, auth_email, auth_status, CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(session_cookies, '')) > 15 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_cookie, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name IN ('SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub') ) s) AS social_sso_rows, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (site_name) * FROM portal_apply_limits ORDER BY site_name ASC ) l) AS limit_rows, (SELECT row_to_json(ws) FROM (SELECT auth_email, auth_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name = 'CareerPulse_Web_Session' LIMIT 1) ws) AS web_session, (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM master_resume_state m WHERE id = 1) AS master_resume, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rc)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM reference_contacts_cache ORDER BY company_name ASC ) rc) AS ref_contacts, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ea)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM job_hunter_email_alerts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15 ) ea) AS email_alerts;
